doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Building his first drum set from a Boston trio job
summary: He bought a cymbal or tom-tom each week while playing nights in the Italian section of Boston.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: When did you get your first drum set, or first drum?

First drum. Good idea. I never had a complete set when I started. I had bits. When I was still in high school, I was working, I think, five nights a week in the Italian section of Boston. We had to play shows there for tap dancers and play for singers. It was just a little trio. Each week I would buy either another cymbal or a tom-tom. I built the set like that.
What did you start off with?
I started off with a snare drum that one of my teenage buddies had got someplace for me. I don’t know where he got it.
Do you remember the hours, starting when, and how long you played?
It was probably from either 9 to 12, 8 to 12, something like that. I think I got off at 12 o’clock at night.
